review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role oversees the end-to-end technical vision and execution of Nesba’s financial management and multi-broker investing platform, leading the engineering team in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, bank-grade, and secure software systems. Day-to-day responsibilities include architecting open-API integrations with brokerage partners, building behavioral tracking and financial health calculation engines, leading architecture and code reviews, and ensuring rigorous data protection
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Senior Software Engineering Manager is a full-time, hybrid role based in Cairo, Egypt, with flexibility for partial work from home.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, with comfort leading hybrid teams in a fast-paced Cairo startup environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The Senior Software Engineering Manager will collaborate closely with product, design, operations, and compliance to ship seamless spending, gamified learning, and multi-account investment features aligned with Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) requirements. QualificationsTrack record of recruiting, mentoring, and retaining high-performing software engineering teams in high-growth or startup environments. 4-6 years of proven experience defining technical direction, architecting scalable cloud infrastructure, and building distributed systems capable of handling high-volume financial data and real-time processing. Strong hands-on engineering background with modern tech stacks, microservices architecture, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with deep expertise in CI/CD automation and automated testing.
